entities.name: Fudaiju
entities.description: Giant tree in Jukai forest, with the Spiral Path and a Sacred Bell, defended by monks.

entities.name: Kazuki
entities.description: Budoka monk who believed Fudaiju was taller than Boseiju and the Center Tree.

entities.name: Jugan
entities.description: Kami who sided with mortals against fellow kami.

entities.name: Ayumi
entities.description: Kami who reclaimed abandoned places and slaughtered the monks of Fudaiju.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War of the kami against mortals on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Battle of Silk
entities.description: Great Battle of Kamigawa lasting six years.

events.summary: Fudaiju is attacked by the kami and defended by Jugan, starting the six-year Battle of Silk.
events.quote: This started one of the Great Battles of Kamigawa , the Battle of Silk, which lasted six years.

events.summary: After six years Ayumi answers the bell and slaughters every monk, leaving Fudaiju depopulated.
events.quote: she slaughtered every last monk, leaving Fudaiju depopulated
